title: docs(pm-dispatch): four passages follow the area and grading rules
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x8Be2AAcUBhodBsvnWLd3Xs)_

Fixes #35230

Rule-change: ruled
Ruling-ref: the maintainer's 「同意」 (2026-11-18 16:19Z) to the fleet skills review order, quoted in #35230's body
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感;只改车队派发规则里四处与现行专题、定级规则相抵的措辞。
- 为什么做:车队技能清理专题的第二步,把审阅报告点出、与你已同意的专题和定级新规则仍相抵的句子改齐。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是某个席位读错一句规则,例如按旧口径数分区门槛;纯文字,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

Four passages in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`, one minimal edit each, plus three twins of S3's old form aligned in patch round 1 (see Acceptance notes). The four are the in-lease rows the reconciliation on the card (comment 7139659486) left as still contradicting the merged area and grading rules. Each was re-read on the tree at `938a48f11` before it was cut; nothing else is edited.

| # | File:line | Old | New | Rule it contradicted |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| S1 | `SKILL.md:97` (index row for `references/area-lease.md`) | `open p1/p2 越分区阈值即可启用` | `可认领卡越分区阈值即启用` | `references/area-lease.md:9` counts every claimable card (「可认领卡 ≥15 张」), and North Star Priority rule 3 says the grade only decides whether a card jumps the queue. The index row still counted p1/p2 only. |
| S2 | `references/area-lease.md:27` | `定级照 SKILL.md 域车道(` | ``定级照 `filing-gate.md`(`` | Every card is graded at filing by the table. The lane section of `SKILL.md` no longer carries a grading clause (its line 180 reads 「`domain:*` 与队列只由分诊落笔」), so the pointer sent the reader to the retired triage-only rule. Grading lives in `references/filing-gate.md` (定级判据). |
| S3 | `references/lanes/qa.md:7` | `未暂停专题子卡全关` | `未暂停 epic 子卡全关` | North Star Product areas: "An area is a standing label and opens no issue … A sub-epic is a temporary `pm:epic` issue that the maintainer opens". A bare 专题 now reads as the `area:*`; child cards and a milestone exist only on a sub-epic, which is what the signal means: its child cards closing, not the sub-epic issue. |
| S4 | `references/triage-duties.md:108` | `非 hold 的降级` | `降级` | North Star Priority rule 3: "A paused area no longer demotes its cards to p3: the grade reflects severity". `references/state-machine.md:17` and the `pm:on-hold` row of `SKILL.md` both say entering hold does not demote. The carve-out implied a hold demotion still exists. |

- Reconciliation of the review reports' section 2 against the merged rules: comment 7139659486 on the card (91 rows; these four are what it left open in this area's lease).
- Out-of-lease leftovers: #37060's items, now a row on the open sweep card #35768 (comment 7140919029; #37060 was closed as folded on 2026-11-24), and C18's third item (`.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md:44`, the `area:records-forms` selector) as a row beside it (comment 7148260783).
- Cloud repository halves of C18 (cloud checklist-test line 96) and B-11, not verified from here: handed to cloud seat 1 with `Request: cloud-confirm` on its mailbox #36556 (comment 7148268774).

### Byte ratchet (no ceiling row moves)

| File | Before | After | Delta | Ceiling | Headroom after |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | 33919 | 33917 | −2 | 33919 | 2 |
| `references/area-lease.md` | 6584 | 6582 | −2 | 6586 | 4 |
| `references/lanes/qa.md` | 2235 | 2235 | 0 | 2235 | 0 |
| `references/triage-duties.md` | 13709 | 13696 | −13 | 13709 | 13 |
| `references/filing-gate.md` | 9124 | 9123 | −1 | 9124 | 1 |

Net −18 bytes. Before and after are merge-base readings; merged with current `main`, `area-lease.md` reads one byte less. `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` is not edited: the gate is green with the headroom above, and lowering is permitted, not required.

## Tests

Text-only change to fleet rule files; no tested behaviour changed, so there is no ablation.

<details><summary>Local gates: 25 derived, 25 run, final exit 0 on each (head 979070ff5); patch round re-checks (head f681d0d5c)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (change set from the merge base `938a48f11`, 4 paths): 25 commands.
- Every one ended at exit 0, exit code captured before any pipe. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 (prerequisite not met: `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` not built); after `turbo run build` of those two under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0) it exited 0.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`: exit 0; the four files read 33917 (ceiling 33919), 6582 (ceiling 6586), 2235 (ceiling 2235), 13697 (ceiling 13709).
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`: exit 0, "131 file(s) clean".
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: "25 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 25 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 25 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness` (local-only family, run because `SKILL.md` holds the decision frame): exit 0, frame unchanged.
- Patch round 1 at `f681d0d5c`: `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` green (qa.md 2235, triage-duties.md 13696, filing-gate.md 9123); `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` clean (2 commits); `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` VERDICT clean exit 0, merges cleanly with origin/main `49c8e0f06`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- No script, test or other document pins any of the four old phrases: `git grep -F` over the whole tree for 「越分区阈值」, 「定级照 SKILL」, 「未暂停专题」 and 「非 hold」 hit only the four edited lines (positive control: 「可认领卡 ≥15」 hits `area-lease.md`).
- S3, one reading corrected: an area can be paused (Priority rule 3 names "a held or paused area"), so the contradiction is not the word 未暂停. It is that an area has no child cards and no milestone; only a sub-epic has them.
- Patch round 1 (head `f681d0d5c`, after L1 REWORK 7148232655 and contract review 7148207989 S1/N2): S3 now reads 「未暂停 epic 子卡全关」 (byte-neutral), so it keeps 子卡 and names the sub-epic's child cards. The same old form 「专题子卡」 is aligned to 「epic 子卡」 at `references/triage-duties.md:93` and `references/filing-gate.md:7` and `:50` (−1 byte each). No 「专题子卡」 or 「子专题卡」 is left in `.claude/**`. `references/seat-lifecycle.md` 57 and 63 keep their wording: 57's 其子卡 belongs to the 子专题 its line 53 defines, and 63's 暂停专题 sits beside 父单 in the same sentence. N1 (「即启用」) is left as accepted.
- S2 keeps its parenthesis: the lane seat's self-triage exception is still in `references/triage-duties.md` (lines 32–35).
- S4 leaves the human floor reading "every demotion goes to the maintainer". No rule in the tree demotes on hold any more, so no action that was free before is now on the floor.
- No changeset: `.claude/**` ships in no package (`skip-changeset`).

## Verification

Files to read first, by risk: `references/triage-duties.md` line 108 (S4, the human-floor line); `references/lanes/qa.md` line 7 (S3, the patched wording); `references/area-lease.md` line 27 (S2, the pointer target); `SKILL.md` line 97 (S1).

Two-minute check: `git diff --stat 938a48f11 f681d0d5c` prints five files and "5 files changed, 7 insertions(+), 7 deletions(-)".
